name: medinteract-workspace
description: Scripts de verificação de build e execução do ecossistema MedInteract (Java + Python + React)

scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run check:java && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:python: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& 'backend/ai-engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -m py_compile backend/ai-engine/main.py backend/ai-engine/cli_chat.py backend/ai-engine/app/db/models.py backend/ai-engine/app/db/session.py backend/ai-engine/app/services/rag_service.py backend/ai-engine/app/services/prompt_service.py backend/ai-engine/app/api/endpoints/chat.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'backend/ai-engine/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' backend/ai-engine/tests/test_backend_core.py"
